external_trace_semantics.merge_rule: sort by start_us then union overlapping or directly abutting windows
external_trace_semantics.anchor_semantics: canonical runs will define each eligible compromise anchor as the end of a merged source observation-opportunity window; the runner itself receives only later relative windows

hypothetical_rate_semantics.capacity_semantics: extension-model hypothetical uniform net payload bytes available only during accepted observation-opportunity windows; not measured SatNOGS throughput

horizons.deadline_rule: TRUST_RESTORED must occur at elapsed_microseconds strictly less than horizon_microseconds
horizons.window_clipping_rule: a window starting before the horizon is clipped at the horizon boundary for byte-capacity arithmetic; windows starting at or after the horizon are excluded

scheduler.rule: within each observation-opportunity window, repeatedly transmit the highest-priority ready incomplete object; newly unlocked objects may use remaining capacity in the same window; partial bytes persist except under A1
scheduler.byte_integrity: all transferred cryptographic bytes are integer bytes
scheduler.object_actionability: an object becomes actionable only after all bytes have arrived

disruption_adaptation.A1_DROP_FIRST_LARGEST_OBJECT_FRAGMENT: same Study 8 tie-break and semantics: the first allocation in the first window carrying the selected largest object is discarded once; consumed capacity is not restored; retransmission may use remaining capacity in that same window if any
disruption_adaptation.A2_DELAY_FIRST_TRANSITION_PROOF_ONE_CONT: when transition proof first becomes ready, the first eligible observation-opportunity window at that point is consumed for the delay and no transition-proof bytes are sent in that window; later eligible windows may continue
disruption_adaptation.A3_STALE_EPOCH_REPLAY_AT_COMMIT: at the first logical commit opportunity, stale replay is rejected, consumes that observation-opportunity window for commit progression, adds zero modeled bytes, increments the transition-attempt counter once, and defers legitimate commit to a later eligible window

visible_inputs: frozen future observation-opportunity windows inside selected horizon
p3_guard.rule: before sending new_epoch_commit_signature, remaining modeled capacity strictly before the horizon, including unused bytes in the current window, must be at least the unsent commit-signature bytes plus unsent post-commit-confirmation bytes

state_costs.legacy_exposure: integer elapsed microseconds from anchor to commit or horizon for P1/P2/P3; zero for P0
state_costs.control_unavailable: integer elapsed microseconds from anchor to commit or horizon for P0; zero for P1/P2/P3
state_costs.dual_epoch_overlap: integer elapsed microseconds from proof acceptance to commit or horizon for P2; zero for all other policies

minimum_rate_solver.target: smallest positive integer rate_bps producing TRUST_RESTORED under the exact trace/profile/policy/disruption/horizon condition
minimum_rate_solver.structural_infeasibility: if success cannot occur even when every non-empty eligible window is treated as having enough bytes to finish all currently transmissible objects, return no finite threshold
minimum_rate_solver.search_method: deterministic monotone integer binary search after a deterministic upper-bound doubling phase

synthetic_fixture_requirements: minimum-rate solver returns exact smallest integer bps on hand-constructed fixtures
